title: Yellow Veggie Curry, Rice and Cucumber Pickle
subtitle: Just heat, combine and eat!
description: When time's short but you still want to make a meal – and one the whole fam-bam approves of – our amazing pre-prepped, pre-cooked and fast-cook ingredients do the hard yakka for you. All you need to do is a quick heat here, a little assembly there, and boom! Dinner is done, dinner is dusted and dinner is delish.

steps.text: Make cucumber pickle: Coarsely chop the cucumber. Juice half the lemon, then cut the remaining lemon into wedges. Combine the cucumber, 1 tsp lemon juice, peanuts and a pinch of sugar in a bowl. Season with salt and stir to combine. Set aside to pickle, tossing occasionally, until needed.

Heat curry and rice: Put the vegetable curry in a microwave-safe bowl. Heat in the microwave for 3 mins, then stir. Heat for a further 2-3 mins until hot. Massage the packet of rice to loosen and tear a 2cm opening for the steam to escape. Heat in the microwave for 90 secs or until warmed through.
Serve up: Divide the rice, curry and cucumber pickle among bowls. Scatter with the fried shallots and serve with the lemon wedges. Enjoy!
...: That's it folks. You whipped that up in no time at all!
